meta.title: Dream11 Fantasy Points System — Cricket / T20
meta.retrievalNote: On 2026-10-10 the live official page returned a 'Server down!' error, so every value below was transcribed from the Wayback Machine copy of that official page (T20 tab, panel #t20). The 2026-01-06 and 2026-01-14 captures are identical.
meta.scopeNote: These are Dream11's current T20 rules applied to a 2022 match for demonstration. They are not the rules that were in force in October 2022.

rules.label: Dismissal for a duck
rules.verbatim: Dismissal for a duck Batter, Wicket-Keeper & All-Rounder -2

rules.label: Playing Substitute (Concussion, COVID-19, X-Factor, or Impact Player)
rules.verbatim: Playing Substitute (Concussion, COVID-19, X-Factor, or Impact Player) +4

strikeRate.label: Strike Rate (Except Bowler)
strikeRate.noteVerbatim: Negative points for low batting Strike Rates are only applicable for individual Strike Rates of 70 runs per 100 balls or below.

officialNotesVerbatim: Any player scoring a century will only get points for the century. No points will be awarded as their 30 run Bonus or Half-century Bonus. Additionally, no points are awarded for centuries in T10 matches.

If any runs are scored on an overthrow, points for those runs will be credited to the batter on strike for that ball. However, if the overthrow goes for a boundary, the batter will not receive extra Boundary Bonus points.

A direct hit is inflicted by the fielder who is the only one to touch the ball after the batter faces the delivery. In all other cases, points will be awarded only to the last 2 fielders who touch the ball.
Players taking more than 3 catches will also get 4 points as 3 Catch Bonus. For example, if a player takes 6 catches, he/she will not get 8 points.
No points will be awarded for any actions during a Super Over or a Super Five.

howFourthManAppliesThem.reading: 'Run +1' is applied to runs credited to the batter on the official scorecard. Byes, leg-byes, wides and the one-run no-ball penalty are extras, not the batter's runs, so no batting points are assigned for them. The page lists no separate rule for extras.
A six is scored as 6 x 'Run' plus 'Six Bonus'. 'Boundary Bonus' is treated as the bonus for fours and is not added on top of a six.
Rates are only scored once an innings is complete, using the official scorecard's final runs and balls. Values are rounded to 2 decimals before matching a band. A value between bands earns 0.

notDefinedOnPage.topic: Dot Ball (+1) on a wicket delivery
notDefinedOnPage.decision: Not awarded — marked unavailable. The page lists 'Dot Ball +1' but does not say whether a delivery that takes a wicket counts.

notDefinedOnPage.topic: Dot Ball (+1) on a delivery with byes
notDefinedOnPage.decision: Not awarded — marked unavailable. The page does not say how byes interact with the Dot Ball rule.
